source_review.suspect_host: Gossypium arboreum (monarch host legitimacy questioned by Greenstein et al. 2022, not automatically established nonhost)

definitions.native: WCVP extant non-doubtful plant distributions with introduced=0
definitions.contemporary: all WCVP extant non-doubtful region rows
definitions.introduced_only: union contemporary host geography minus union native host geography
definitions.quality: Species-level H3 high quality evidence is not assumed to apply to every region/cultivation phenotype

audit_required: exact WCVP accepted species resolution and accepted ID
native and introduced region counts for the missing species
region codes reclassified from introduced-only to native vs genuinely newly supplied opportunities
no area added by a host is interpreted as colonization
explicit Puerto Rico cell check if codes present
stop: If accepted taxon ambiguous or frozen baseline drift, abort. No manuscript change. This one-butterfly sensitivity cannot support general host quality conclusions.
